business_uid.description: The business the allowance belongs to (e.g., "ixfxpxc7s7shyf0m")

period.description: How the allowance renews. **monthly**: resets every month on the day of the month the subscription was created; **life_long**: a pack that never resets (e.g., "monthly")

credit.description: The units the allowance grants per period; null when the allowance is unlimited (e.g., 300000)

consumed.description: The units used in the current period (e.g., 96000)

left.description: credit minus consumed; negative after an overdraw. Null when the allowance is unlimited, which is never reported as -1 (e.g., 204000)

resets_at.description: When a monthly allowance starts its next period. Null for life_long, and for an allowance that ends on or before that day (e.g., "2026-10-10T00:00:00Z")

expires_at.description: When the allowance ends, for any period; null when it has no end date (e.g., "2027-02-01T00:00:00Z")

description: A quota balance is the state of one allowance subscription of a business in its current period: what it grants, what was used and what is left. There is one row per allowance; the combined number per SKU is in the list response's meta.totals. Webhook: when an allowance's left crosses from above zero to zero or below, a model update with class `quota_balance` and event `exhausted` is published, once per allowance per period and never for an unlimited allowance. Register a webhook on entity `quota_balance`, event `exhausted`; its payload is `{ subscription_uid, business_uid, sku, period, window_start, left, exhausted_at }`, where left is how far the allowance went (0 or negative) and exhausted_at is when the usage happened. It is a fact, not an instruction: a business with another allowance left can keep consuming.
